source.value_from: The PoC-derived BPF filter string is inserted into the libpcap scanner.; value `xbuf`; from `in_buffer = pcap__scan_string(xbuf ? xbuf : "", scanner);`

sink.description: Second free of opt_state->edges during optimizer cleanup after opt_init already freed it on an error path.

root_cause.description: Partial-allocation error path frees opt_state->edges and opt_state->blocks before calling opt_error(), but the longjmp handler later calls opt_cleanup() on the same opt_state.

tainted_value_origin.description: Parsing the attacker-controlled filter builds compiler/optimizer state cstate.ic that determines optimizer block/edge allocation sizes and error paths.

coarse_trace.summary: Attacker-controlled filter text is scanned and parsed into compiler state.
pcap_compile invokes bpf_optimize on parsed icode.
bpf_optimize installs a setjmp cleanup handler and calls opt_init.
opt_init frees partially initialized fields before invoking opt_error on allocation failure.
The setjmp error handler calls opt_cleanup, which frees the same fields again.

fine_trace.note: Project parser source: fuzz_filter makes a NUL-terminated filter string from the PoC, and pcap_compile loads it into the scanner here.
The attacker-controlled filter is parsed into compiler state, including the icode later optimized.
The parsed filter program is passed into the optimizer.
bpf_optimize installs a longjmp error handler that will call opt_cleanup on partially initialized opt_state.
ASan allocation context for the object later freed twice.
The failing path occurs when this later allocation fails after edges/blocks/levels were already allocated.
Root cause: opt_init performs local cleanup before opt_error(), but opt_error longjmps to bpf_optimize where centralized cleanup will run again.
opt_error transfers control back to the setjmp handler in bpf_optimize without clearing freed pointers.
The error handler invokes centralized cleanup on opt_state after the partial cleanup in opt_init.
ASan crash location: opt_cleanup frees opt_state->edges a second time.
